thread.title: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Has Shared Apple Watch Series 4 Videos On YouTube

author: Jasmin Chavez
title: Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Has Shared Apple Watch Series 4 Videos On YouTube
text:
October 14, 2018 Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) Has Shared Apple Watch Series 4 Videos On YouTube
On this weekend, Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) has shared Apple Watch series 4 videos on its YouTube channel, which are relatively basic, and these videos are covering the Workout application, and these are also using the Emergency SOS mode.
“How to start a Workout” on the device is simply covers in the first Apple Watch video. Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) touts that it is bit simpler and only takes a couple taps, just to kick-start your workout, and become quite simple when you’re using an “Apple Watch” for it. “How to use an open goal running workout” is basically highlighted in the video, and how to track your progress, and Apple Watch is best, as for use the post-Workout summary features concerns.
Next most important feature highlighted in the second new Apple Watch’s “how to video highlights device’s Emergency SOS” feature. The company also explains that the side button should be pressed and hold, and slide the Emergency SOS slider, if you want to make an urgent call to emergency services. For accessing your Medical ID this same way is also very easy, Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL) shows off it in the video.
On its YouTube channel, Apple has regularly shared how to videos, over the last several product releases, just to kept its fans engaged and attracted towards the product, and the “Apple Watch Series 4” is no different. About Jasmin Chavez
